name: limit-check-precedes-version-gate-rejected
description: An input that is both structurally over-limit (nesting depth 6) and names an unrecognised identity_version (spec999) refuses input_limit_exceeded: the structural check runs first and the version can never be read.
notes: Structural limits are checked before identity_version is read, since the byte cap and depth pre-scan exist precisely to make parsing safe enough to reach it: an input violating a structural limit refuses input_limit_exceeded even when its identity_version is also unsupported. This vector combines both defects at once (identity_version 'spec999', which this parser does not implement, and a refs array nested one level past the maximum depth of 5, reaching depth 6) and must refuse input_limit_exceeded, not unsupported_identity_version, because the depth guard fires at the strict parse stage before the version can be read at all. input_bytes is used rather than input because the point under test is strict-parse-stage precedence on raw text; see schemas/vectors/README.md, input vs input_bytes.
